      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change mempool data structures, acceptance, eviction, or transaction relay policy."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes net_processing.cpp and blockencodings to pass deserialization parameters and drop malformed peer messages early.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Mitigates a peer-triggered memory exhaustion DoS attack by rejecting un-validatable transactions and blocks early in message deserialization. According to commit 82cd7e7427, this prevents a peer from making the node allocate memory for ~400,000 empty CTransaction objects in a single 4 MB block message or triggering repeated multi-megabyte vector reallocations."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies transaction primitive deserialization rather than the shared serialization framework or utility libraries.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify generic serialization primitives or shared node utilities; changes are specific to transaction structures and P2P handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes transaction deserialization checks in src/primitives/transaction.h, bounding maximum input and output allocations across all transaction deserialization.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Bounds memory allocation during transaction deserialization while ensuring consensus rules cannot be violated. It touches consensus primitive deserialization, requiring validation review to confirm that bounds only reject transactions that could never be valid in any block."
    }
